description: Internal redex wire under COMMUTE (contract DEFAULT): gamma (arity 2, its two aux wired to EACH OTHER — an aux-to-self internal wire) meets delta (arity 1) at principals. Commutation's equations route the internal wire to the copies that take those boundary slots: the two delta-copies' PRINCIPALS end up wired together — a fresh active pair, Lafont's own picture — which then fires the delta~delta annihilation (arity 1), cross-linking the gamma-copy's own two aux ports. Normal form: one gamma copy with a self-wired aux pair, principal on the tail. Pins that internal wires under commute create real, further-reducing redexes rather than erroring. (The cross-agent flavor, gamma.aux<->delta.aux, is equally legal but diverges under gamma/delta commute — reduce-to-normal-form cases must terminate, so the self-wire flavor pins the semantics.)
